I have always dreamed of visiting Italy! It is famousfor its rich history, incredible culture, and world-knownlandmarks. The first place I want to visit is Rome to seethe ancient Colosseum. I would also love to visit Veniceand take a gondola ride along its beautiful canals. Whilethere, I want to explore local markets, try deliciousauthentic pizza and pasta, and buy some unique souvenirsto bring home. Traveling to Italy would be anunforgettable experience to learn about its history andenjoy its wonderful traditions!
I would love to visit Japan! It is a beautiful country with rich history, amazingculture, and famous landmarks. First, I want to go to Tokyo to see the big city andmodern life. Then, I want to visit Mount Fuji and see its traditional temples. I alsowant to try real Japanese sushi and ramens. I will buy cute souvenirs to remembermy trip. Visiting Japan will be a fun way to learn new things and experience a newculture!
